title: Confinement and catalysis in designed peptide barrels
publisher: Zenodo; originating researchers: Petrenas, Rokas (University of Bristol); Oliver, Thomas A.A. (University of Bristol); Woolfson, Derek N. (University of Bristol)
deterministic_selection_rule: Complete main_data.zip and crystal-structure ZIP; 1.638 GB supplementary archive excluded.

substitution.reason: Dryad public individual-download endpoints returned HTTP 403; API payload endpoints required authorization; public browser navigation timed out. No successful payload transfer. Approved reserve used.

measurement_dates.description: Public release 2025-01-11; precise measurement times must be obtained per instrument acquisition header and are not asserted for the whole study.
measurement_dates.status: documented where explicit; otherwise unknown, never inferred from release

author_preprocessing: Mixed instrument files, processed spectroscopic tables, structural refinement products and computational/model context. Included source scripts and pickle objects were not executed/deserialized.
known_analyses_and_limitations: The data support Confinement and Catalysis Within De Novo Designed Peptide Barrels. This selection is a complete source main-data package, not the complete record; excluded supplementary data may be needed for particular supporting claims.
